text: そだて　はじめた　ポケモン　たたかわせよう　かな！

structure.jp: そだて　はじめた　ポケモン
たたかわせよう　かな！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: そだて　はじめた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. そだて　はじめた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon I've started raising'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せ in the middle of the verb means making or letting someone else do it. たたかわせよう = 'I'll have it battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ようかな
patterns.span: たたかわせよう　かな
patterns.explanation: The よう ending says 'I'll do it', and かな after it turns that into wondering aloud. たたかわせよう　かな = 'maybe I'll have it battle'.
